title: ISW Cross-Correlation Predictions for Energy-Flow Cosmology with DESI DR1 Tracers
abstract: Computes ISW-galaxy cross-correlation C_l^Tg for EFC using linear perturbation theory, introducing the cancellation metric C to quantify opposite-sign contributions from standard and transition kernels.

efc_context.regime_relevance: Transition redshift z_t = 0.82 overlap with DESI tracers

key_results: Cancellation metric C increases monotonically with tracer z_eff overlap with z_t
EFC predicts A_ISW = 0.29-0.56 vs LCDM A_ISW = 1.0
Kernel decomposition shows opposite-sign K_mu and K_mu_prime near z_t
